scope: Read-only public-source registry for Miller North. Inclusion does not mean every record from a source is relevant or publication-safe.

sources.date_coverage: 1991-present, with older category indexes described on the official page
sources.query_method: year/category indexes plus bounded site and CKAN API search
sources.update_frequency: schedule described as almost weekly; reports as completed
sources.limitations: Full reports are separate resources; reports cannot determine legal responsibility.
sources.robots_access_considerations: Use public indexes and CKAN metadata; no access-control bypass.

sources.date_coverage: public inquiry recommendations represented in the current workbook
sources.query_method: CKAN package metadata and versioned XLSX resource
sources.pagination_behavior: single workbook; rows by recommendation and responder
sources.latest_bounded_cycle: Maskwacis: 62 responder rows across 40 numbered recommendations; repeated run found 0 added, changed or removed rows.
sources.limitations: One recommendation can have multiple responder rows; response labels are not proof of implementation.
sources.robots_access_considerations: Public CKAN API and download only.

sources.agency: Office of the Chief Medical Examiner
sources.date_coverage: current service information
sources.query_method: official pages and linked public reports
sources.limitations: Individual medical examiner files are not a public searchable incident corpus.
sources.robots_access_considerations: Public informational pages only; do not request private records.

sources.agency: College of Physicians and Surgeons of Alberta
sources.date_coverage: ten-year decision window, with statutory exceptions
sources.query_method: decision index and bounded site search using mechanism vocabulary
sources.limitations: Most complaints are not public and decisions may not record Indigenous identity.
sources.robots_access_considerations: Public decisions only.

sources.date_coverage: current schedule plus annual archives; historical depth varies
sources.query_method: annual indexes, verdict links, recommendation-response links and bounded site search
sources.update_frequency: as inquests are scheduled or completed
sources.latest_bounded_cycle: Thirty-four verdict PDFs from 2024–2026 were fingerprinted; an identical replay reported 34 unchanged documents and no false new events.
sources.limitations: Inquests are fact-finding, not fault-finding; some verdicts or responses may not be posted.
sources.robots_access_considerations: Public pages and linked documents only.

sources.date_coverage: published panel reports and responses
sources.query_method: report index, response links, title and full-text mechanism terms
sources.limitations: Often aggregate/systemic; do not manufacture individual incidents from cohort reports.
sources.robots_access_considerations: Public reports only.

sources.date_coverage: current access rules; pre-1971 records directed to archives
sources.query_method: document access map only; no automated requesting
sources.limitations: Release depends on valid interest or public-interest determination; autopsy/toxicology access is more restricted.
sources.robots_access_considerations: Do not submit requests or collect private records automatically.

sources.agency: BC College of Nurses and Midwives
sources.date_coverage: current public notices and linked archives
sources.query_method: public notice index plus bounded site search using Indigenous and mechanism terms
sources.latest_bounded_cycle: Notices 1000–1133 were fetched without error; body-only screening found no new explicit Indigenous-healthcare candidate and replay reported all 133 unchanged.
sources.limitations: Not every complaint is public; search templates can create false positives from navigation text.
sources.robots_access_considerations: Public notices only; exclude private complaint information.

sources.date_coverage: published FNHA reports and updates
sources.query_method: FNHA report/news indexes and bounded site search
sources.limitations: Source roles vary; reports may be systemic or case-specific.
sources.robots_access_considerations: Public material only; treat Indigenous-led reporting as primary for its own findings and governance statements.

sources.date_coverage: current and historical public documents; exact index coverage not clearly stated
sources.query_method: official service links, Publications Centre records and bounded site search
sources.pagination_behavior: Publications Centre catalogue; API behavior requires further documentation
sources.limitations: Publications Centre is a client-rendered catalogue and its API timed out during bounded testing.
sources.robots_access_considerations: Use public catalogue/download endpoints; do not circumvent access restrictions.

sources.date_coverage: current access information
sources.query_method: access-policy map only; no automated requesting
sources.limitations: Individual reports are request-based and can contain sensitive information.
sources.robots_access_considerations: No requests submitted; no private records collected.

sources.date_coverage: current newsroom and indexed archives
sources.query_method: news index plus bounded site search using case and mechanism terms
sources.limitations: Institutional statements are evidence of the institution's position and claimed actions, not independent findings.
sources.robots_access_considerations: Public statements only.

sources.agency: College of Physicians and Surgeons of Saskatchewan
sources.date_coverage: public discipline and current regulator material
sources.query_method: decision index and bounded site search
sources.limitations: Public decisions may not identify patient background; avoid inference from context or names.
sources.robots_access_considerations: Public material only.

sources.date_coverage: published aviation investigations and occurrence data
sources.query_method: aviation occurrence and report indexes limited to air ambulance, medevac and remote patient transport relevance
sources.update_frequency: as occurrences and investigations are published
sources.limitations: TSB does not cover ordinary road collisions; an occurrence is in scope only with a healthcare/patient-transport connection.
sources.robots_access_considerations: Public aviation records only.

sources.date_coverage: hearing decisions from 2018; agreements/undertakings may be published from 2021
sources.query_method: year index, decision full text and bounded mechanism/entity search
sources.limitations: Not all decisions are published and identity/background may not be stated; annual totals are parent-regulator statistics only.
sources.robots_access_considerations: Public decisions only; never infer Indigenous identity.

sources.date_coverage: current public notices and regulatory information
sources.query_method: official notice pages and bounded site search
sources.limitations: Public searchability and historical coverage are less structured than Alberta's index.
sources.robots_access_considerations: Public notices only.

sources.date_coverage: current public hearing material
sources.query_method: hearing index and bounded site search
sources.limitations: The page establishes a public hearing process; public decision coverage and Indigenous-specific discoverability require more testing.
sources.robots_access_considerations: Public materials only.

sources.date_coverage: searchable historical news releases; exact start date not stated
sources.query_method: query-specific news search, filters and RSS rather than bulk catalogue retrieval
sources.latest_bounded_cycle: Narrow government-news searches surfaced two 2026 custody-medical-distress inquest notices; both remain private pending verdicts and explicit Indigenous relevance.
sources.limitations: News releases are notices or institutional statements, not the underlying inquest record unless a report is linked.
sources.robots_access_considerations: Public search and RSS only.

sources.date_coverage: public SIRT notices and reports since the agency became operational
sources.query_method: government-news search plus document-specific Publications API download URLs
sources.pagination_behavior: news search pagination; one document per public product/format identifier
sources.update_frequency: as investigations are opened or concluded
sources.limitations: Most records concern policing rather than health care; include only a direct hospital, EMS, mental-health or patient-safety connection, and never infer Indigenous identity from community alone.
sources.robots_access_considerations: Use public news and direct public document URLs; no bulk API circumvention.

sources.date_coverage: published tribunal decisions and current judicial-review index
sources.query_method: decision search, cited-case branching and bounded health-care/Indigenous mechanism terms
sources.update_frequency: as decisions and judicial reviews are published
sources.limitations: A complaint, preliminary ruling, merits decision, remedy and judicial review are different procedural stages and must not be conflated.
sources.robots_access_considerations: Public decisions only; minimize personal detail in projections.

sources.date_coverage: published tribunal decisions
sources.query_method: decision index and bounded Indigenous/health-care mechanism search, with CanLII corroboration where available
sources.limitations: Bounded review found no new direct Indigenous health-care merits decision; pleadings and preliminary rulings must not be described as findings.
sources.robots_access_considerations: Public decisions only.

sources.date_coverage: varies by court and tribunal
sources.query_method: bounded jurisdiction, tribunal and mechanism queries; branch from a known case or citation
sources.limitations: Search results can include pleadings or decisions unrelated to health-care accountability; verify procedural posture and Indigenous relevance from the judgment itself.
sources.robots_access_considerations: Use public search and decisions; no access-control bypass or bulk scraping.
